services.scheduleSource: Cadence (hourly) is confirmed exactly in LYRA-Handover.md ('known exactly'). The specific minute-of-hour (:00) is NOT recorded anywhere and is only assumed here -- verify the real value in the Railway dashboard.

Cadence (every 5 minutes) is confirmed exactly in LYRA-Handover.md ('known exactly'). The specific offset within each 5-minute window is NOT recorded and is only assumed here -- verify the real value in the Railway dashboard. Note: crons.yml's own 'publish-due-posts' backstop job intentionally runs at :02,:07,:12... to avoid firing in the same minute as this service, which implies (but does not confirm) this service runs on :00,:05,:10...

LYRA-Handover.md explicitly flags this schedule as inferred from cron-job.org's 'next run' timestamps only, not the actual configured interval -- 'treat as best-guess until a few days of side-by-side comparison confirm they match'. Not yet confirmed as of this file's creation. Value here mirrors crons.yml's redundant GitHub Actions backstop cadence for the same job, which is a reasonable but unverified assumption.
